functions.name: formatBytes
functions.docQuote: * Formats a byte count as a human-readable string such as "1.4 MB".
functions.returnsTagQuote: * @returns {string} the formatted size, with a unit suffix such as "KB" or "MB".

functions.name: clamp
functions.docQuote: * Clamps a number to the inclusive range [min, max].
functions.returnsTagQuote: * @returns {number} value, min or max, whichever lies inside the range.

functions.name: parseQuery
functions.docQuote: * Turns an Express-style query string into a plain object.
functions.returnsTagQuote: * @returns {Object} an object whose keys are the query parameter names.

functions.name: buildQuery
functions.docQuote: * Serialises a plain object back into a query string.
functions.returnsTagQuote: * @returns {string} the query string, without a leading "?".
